items.title: Lawrence "Buddy" Tureaud Interview, 1972-03-06
items.q: Me and him used to work together, you see. And otherwise I couldn't do that by myself. Because I used to cut the paper and he'd hang it.

ctx.x: Oh, the Gypsy Tears. We had the wide points, crossing, and then we had to cut the paper to put up there. See, I had a father named Brother, Brother Fortuny, he's there now. Me and him used to work together, you see. And otherwise I couldn't do that by myself. Because I used to cut the paper and he'd hang it. He'd be up on the scapiscator coming down, I'd hand him the paper as he'd run out, you see. And go right along and we'd get through.
Where did you learn how to do that? Just pick it up.
